answer: Make trust grow like a coral reef, not a badge printed at signup: a newcomer locks a small stake in a vault that opens only as its reef grows, one verified job at a time, each branch checked by a different reef-keeper. A sparrow courier carries each check between keepers, so no single clique can certify a fake. Standing thaws slowly, and random tide audits prune branches whose signers repeat, freezing clones before they can trade. Sybil farms must fund a vault, grow a reef, and pass fresh keepers for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
